WindowControls.MinimizeButtonHint: Add a minimize button on all floating windows.
WindowControls.DefaultSizeButtonHint: Add a default size button on all floating windows.
WindowControls.MaximizeButtonHint: Add a maximize button on all floating windows.
WindowControls.OrganizedMinimizeHint: Minimize windows to either the bottom or top taskbar.
WindowControls.PinnedButtonHint: Add a pin button on windows. If clicked, such windows may not be closed, only minimized.
WindowControls.PinnedHeaderColorHint: Base color for pinned window headers (forced to 25% opacity). Pinned taskbar buttons use a 20% darker solid color.
WindowControls.PinnedDoubleTappingName: Double 'ESC' Tapping to minimize Pinned Windows
WindowControls.PinnedDoubleTappingHint: Windows that are currently pinned, will not be minimized when pressing 'ESC', unless it is pressed twice
WindowControls.RememberPinnedHint: Pinned Windows will automatically reopen when starting a new session
WindowControls.ClickOutsideMinimizeHint: Minimize all windows when clicking on the board. Works best with setting: 'left-click to release Objects'.
WindowControls.MaximizeButtonHint: Add a maximize button on resizeable windows. May not work well with all systems
WindowControls.TaskbarColorHint: Color of the Taskbar when 'Top Taskbar' Organized Mode is enabled
WindowControls.TaskbarScrollbarColorHint: Color of the taskbar's horizontal scrollbar thumb. Leave blank to use the theme default.
WindowControls.TaskbarWidthHint: Controls how wide the taskbar bar extends. 'Canvas Only' stops the bar at the sidebar edge, preventing it from overlapping sidebar UI elements.
WindowControls.TaskbarHoverPreviewEnable: Hover over a taskbar button to temporarily preview the hidden window.
WindowControls.TaskbarHoverPreviewDelayH: Delay in milliseconds before the preview shows while hovering.
WindowControls.MaximizeWidthHint: Width of the window when using the Maximize button, as a percentage of the canvas area (10–100).
WindowControls.MaximizeHeightHint: Height of the window when using the Maximize button, as a percentage of the canvas area (10–100).
